messages:
micah: Tiny agenda change before we go live  demo at 10:05, Q&A at 10:20. Posting a sticky in #lobby in 90s. Also heard a faint pop during rehearsal  can AV check source?

rachel-av: Checking. Found intermittent USB hiccup on the presenter hub; switching presenter to dedicated AV machine now.

anya: I'll post the sticky and seed two leadership prompts at Q&A open (roadmap priorities + Dedicated rollout timeline).

ken: Quick ask: can captions be turned on at the start of Q&A? Some colleagues rely on them.

captions-bot: Captions: vendor token valid, latency ~1.2s. Will enable at go-time. If captions drop, fallback = post-meeting transcript + highlight clips.

rachel-av: Also seeing a ~1s slide-camera jitter when presenter alt-tabs. Recommend we keep demo to single laptop and lock presenter view.

micah: Good call. Ken, can you be the single laptop presenter for the demo? We'll have someone advance slides if needed.

jen: I'll join the Q&A for the first 5 minutes to take SLA/timeline questions. No SLA wording changes expected today.

rachel-av: Ops fallback plan: 1) restart capture driver, 2) if jitter >250ms for 30s cut to slides-only layout, 3) if OBS process dies rehost to backup ingest. Failover command below.

rachel-av: ```
# rehost to backup ingest
ssh ops@streambox "curl -X POST https://ingest-backup.internal/v1/failover?stream=all-hands"
```

anya: Sticky posted: "Agenda tweak: demo 10:05, Q&A 10:20. Upvote questions in the thread. We may pause video briefly for audio fixes; captions ON when available"

ken: Presenter switched to AV machine and slide lock enabled. Monitoring audio at -6dB.

captions-bot: Captions enabled. Latency steady.

rachel-av: Final preflight green. Switching to program layout in 45s. If anything weird happens, ping me directly.

micah: Thanks team. After the meeting I'll collate Q&A + follow-ups into #all-hands-summary and attach timecoded clips of any cut segments. See you on-stage in 8. :rocket:
